title: Hukme Shabbir se
body:
hukme shabbir se jo zabt ki deewar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas alamdar hai aisa ghazi
naam se harf e wafa jiske wafadar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk pehchaan alam jaan sakina dil hai
mil ke in cheezon se paikar tera tayyar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafila aale mohamed ka chala jab ghar se
tu alamdar hua khaafila salaar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaye haath qalam mashk bachane ke liye
tere jaisa na zamane mein wafadar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak baazu rahe mashk pe aanch aayi nahi
kat gaye haath to mashkeeza pe tab waar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere qadmon ki badolat hui mashoor furaat
paaon chu kar jo tere pani haya daar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
author: Rehaan Azmi
